title: Chiqan Tronopa
intro: Mä ch’aman apnaqirix jach’a yatiñani ukat jach’a trono ukamp uñt’atawa, mä jan uñt’at yatiyaw mä jan uñt’at chiqat katuqi. Aka jan suyt’at yatiyawix iyawsäwinakaparu ukhamarak autoridadanakaparuw ch’amanchaski, mä diplomático thakhi saräwiruw uñt’ayi, ukax amuyunakaparux yant’ani ukat qhipharux mä jach’a ajay tuqin sartasiwiruw puriyani. ¿Uka apnaqirin khitïnsa ukat kunanakatï taqpach reinopar mayjtʼaykäna ukanak qhanañchtʼasmati?
clues: Markanakajampi nayampixa, nayra achachilanakasan thakinakaparjama, intiru yupaychapxayätha.
Mä jamach’i, mä hoopoe, ukax jan uñjkañ yatiyiriw mä ch’aman irpirin qillqatap apaniwayitu.
Khitir jaqin yatiñap yantʼañatakix wali aski regalonak apayaniyäta, ukampis kuttʼayatäxänwa, kunattix khitir jaqix Allah tuqit jukʼamp qamirïnwa.
Janïr khitan utapar purinkipanxa, jachʼa tronojax mä nayra chʼipxtasaw uka chiqar mä milagro tuqi apayatäna.
Ukar purisajj uka tronojj nayankpachati sasaw jisktʼapjjetäna, ukat nayajj akham sasaw sista: ‘Uka tronojj utjkaspa ukhamawa’ sasa.
Mä jach’a salaruw mantawayta, mä piso uma estanque sasin pantjasiyäta, ukat uka muspharkañ pachanx Sulaiman profetamp chikaw Allah, akapachan Tatituparux katuyasta.

arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds." (27:44)
